contains: typed HTTP clients for all Edge Functions and governance node APIs
rules: domain types inlined as string literals

platform_rules.deletion_test: Deleting any app must leave packages/ compiling without modification. Non-negotiable.
platform_rules.edge_functions_only: Edge Functions are the only layer that touches the database. No direct Supabase calls from apps.
platform_rules.api_clients_only: Frontend communicates through packages/api typed clients only.
platform_rules.domain_ownership: Each app owns its domain under apps/[name]/src/domain/. Nothing leaks into packages/.
platform_rules.packages_frozen: packages/ is frozen at v1.0. No new packages, no restructuring, no domain logic.
platform_rules.one_supabase_per_app: ONE APP = ONE SUPABASE PROJECT. Non-negotiable.
platform_rules.no_next_in_packages: packages/ui has no Next.js dependency and must not acquire one.
platform_rules.core_candidate_rule: Platform grows from patterns proven across ≥2 apps. Never from anticipated future needs.

onboarding_checklist.description: Every new app onboarded to Unami Platform Core must complete all steps.
phase_0_decision: Define the app name and path: apps/[name]/
Define the Supabase project (new project — never share with another app)
Define the domain: what does this app own that no other app touches?
Record the phase definition in PROJECT_STATUS.md
phase_1_scaffold: Copy shell layout template from PLATFORM_DASHBOARD_SHELL.md → src/app/(app)/layout.tsx
Copy nav-main.tsx from apps/umkhandlu or apps/uncip (clean version)
Copy nav-user.tsx — update ROLE_LABELS for product roles
Create src/config/app-config.ts — set name and subtitle
phase_2_shadcn: Install all 31 shadcn primitives (UNCIP-validated complete set):
alert, alert-dialog, avatar, badge, breadcrumb, button, card, checkbox, collapsible,
command, dialog, dropdown-menu, input, input-group, label, pagination, popover, progress,
radio-group, scroll-area, select, separator, sheet, sidebar, skeleton, sonner, switch,
table, tabs, textarea, toggle, toggle-group, tooltip
phase_3_shell_parity: getPreference() reads sidebar_variant + sidebar_collapsible from cookies at layout render
AppSidebar uses isSynced pattern — preferences store drives variant/collapsible after hydration
Verify deletion test: deleting this app leaves packages/ compiling
phase_5_route_states: loading.tsx on every route (PageSkeleton or TableSkeleton)
error.tsx on data-fetching routes (ErrorState with retry)
phase_6_database: Create new Supabase project — never share with another app
Add table grants: GRANT SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE to authenticated
Use SECURITY DEFINER helpers for cross-table RLS to avoid recursion
phase_7_edge_functions: Create supabase/functions/[appname]-[resource]/ for each domain resource
Use npm: import specifiers (Deno Edge Runtime requirement)
All routes require authentication — no debug routes ever
phase_8_api_clients: Implement fromWire() mapper for every client (snake_case → camelCase)
Implement toWire() mapper for outbound requests
Domain types inlined as string literals — no import from app domain
phase_9_verification: Role verification: each role sees correct data
Privacy verification: each role does NOT see incorrect data
Cross-role consistency: same record has same state across roles
Deletion test: deleting this app leaves packages/ compiling

new_app_template.domain: Music creator ecosystem — creator profiles, ISRC registration, rights management, marketplace

core_candidates.description: Patterns discovered in apps that may be promoted to packages/ once proven across ≥2 apps.
candidates: Database privacy ≠ UI disclosure — two separate enforcement layers

Work queue dashboards derived from canonical record state
SECURITY DEFINER RLS helper pattern for cross-table policies
Verification as a separate engineering phase
Actor name denormalisation at write time for audit/timeline records
